What's your return and refund policy?
12:08
Our return and refund policy is designed to ensure a smooth process for you:
Returns:
You have 21 days from the date of delivery to return your items.
Items must be in their original condition – unworn, unwashed, and with tags still attached. Footwear should not have been worn outdoors.
For hygiene reasons, boxers can only be returned if they are unworn, unwashed, and in their original packaging with seals intact.
If your purchase was made in one of our physical stores, returns must be completed in-store within the same 21-day window.
Process:
Register your return through our returns portal.
Post the item(s) back to us within 5 days of registering the return.
Once your return arrives at our warehouse, we aim to process it within 10 days.
After approval, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. You’ll receive an email confirmation once processed.
Refunds:
Refunds for orders paid with a gift card will be issued back to the same gift card.
For split payments, refunds will first be applied to the gift card portion.
If you’ve requested an exchange but the item is unavailable, a refund will be issued instead.
Important Notes:
Until your return reaches our warehouse, the items remain your responsibility. Please package securely and retain proof of postage.
If you use a courier option provided through our returns portal and the parcel doesn’t arrive, we may need time to investigate with the courier.
Returns sent outside the 21-day window will be rejected.
For full details, you can view our refund policy here. If you have further questions, feel free to ask!
